verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is a SaaS accounting product, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question, but the evidence shows no such resource. The llms.txt probe returned HTTP 404, OpenAPI probes all 404, and the API and MCP layer are announced only as coming 'Soon'. The in-product Command assistant is a different feature, not documentation an external agent can be pointed at.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
